_comment: Copy to <project>/.claude/habits.json and edit. All patterns are case-insensitive regexes searched in paths (forward slashes), commands, URLs or queries. docs: files or folders, relative to the project or absolute; a reminder fires at session end if a trigger happened and none of its docs changed afterwards. once_per_session (optional): remind at most once per session, for rules that would otherwise fire every turn. tokens (optional, these are the defaults): context warning past context_warn then every context_step tokens; big_output = tool output size (tokens) that gets a nudge. guards (optional, both default true, no config needed): shell_writes blocks heredoc / multi-line echo / Set-Content writes, inline Python that opens a file for writing and sed -i / perl -i on .md, into non-temp, non-git-ignored files (use Write/Edit); control_chars reports NUL, form feed and other control bytes, invalid UTF-8 and mixed line endings in a just-edited file. experiments (optional): on_command = long-run launches; the first one in a session with no edit to a file matching plan gets a one-time reminder to write the experiment plan (skill experiment-plan); message overrides the default text. block rules: tools (default Bash), pattern, optional unless, message; optional main_only: true skips the rule for subagent calls (for rules about main-session state, such as the working folder).
_comment_knowledge: knowledge_paths: path regexes (matched on absolute forward-slash paths) that only the librarian agent (agent-habits:librarian) may write; Edit/Write and shell writes from anyone else are blocked with a pointer to it. knowledge_map: the doc(s) the librarian reads to place a fact. knowledge_audit: input of scripts/kb_audit.py and the librarian-audit skill (files / folders of .md, code_roots searched for cited names and paths, repos whose commits may be cited, report path, optional index = entry index file that Find mode greps first (git-ignore it: it's rewritten after every File call), optional transcripts = Claude Code project folders whose librarian runs are counted, default the project's and the code roots'). to_librarian (on a reminder): its stop message also says to hand findings to the librarian.
_comment_habits: habits (optional): edits the habits text injected at session start. drop = bullet ids from the plugin's habits.md (the [id] after each '- '); extra = lines appended as written. Also read from the user-level ~/.claude/habits.json ($CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), where only this key counts, so a drop there applies to every project; drops and extras from both files add up. An unknown id is reported at session start. Bullets for the knowledge base, tasks, reminders and the shell-write guard are left out on their own when the project doesn't configure them.
_comment_tasks: tasks (optional, the admin part; habits-setup scaffolds it): input of the project's tools/tasks.py (copied from the plugin's scripts/tasks.py) and the scheduler agent. dir = task folder (one <prefix><n>-<slug>.md per task, headers **Status:** / **Needs you:** / **Links:**); prefix = id prefix; plan (optional file: lane tables under ### headings), index, done = relative to dir (the done list is <done>/<index>). Defaults: docs/tasks, T-, PLAN.md, README.md, done. precommit: a command or a list the plugin's .githooks/pre-commit template runs from the repo root (CHECKS_COMMIT=1 set, no stdin, on the working tree); a failure blocks the commit. shared_index_guard (opt-in, default false): that hook also blocks whole-index commits, for several agent sessions committing in one checkout.
_comment_trackers: trackers (optional): the work queue the scheduler agent (agent-habits:scheduler) keeps. map = the doc defining the task format and closing steps; paths = path regexes only the scheduler writes; with tasks set, both default to the task index and to the index, plan and done list (not the task files, whose headers and progress the working session writes), so set them only to override. lists = other lists an item may already live in (checked for duplicates and in the audit); audit = input of the scheduler-audit skill: report path, optional repos (repos whose commits tasks cite, searched with git log --grep <id>) and runs (test-run index files, for failed runs before a pass).
_comment_guards: guards.binary_ext (optional): extra file extensions the control-character guard skips (the project's binary formats), on top of the built-in images / archives / audio / fonts.

block.message: Don't force-push: use --force-with-lease, or ask the user first.

reminders.name: changelog
reminders.message: This session changed user-facing code (src/ edit or a deploy) but CHANGELOG.md has no newer edit. Add a line under Unreleased, or say why this change doesn't need one.

reminders.name: knowledge
reminders.message: This session did research (probes, reference reads, docs lookups) but docs/knowledge/ has no newer edit. Record what was learned (Status + Evidence; tested / researched / guess), or say why nothing new was learned.
